Verify the line against Iraqi Ministry of Oil / SOPC (State Oil Pipelines Company) gas-network documentation before trusting name/56 km/18 in/2 bcm-y; confirm whether it is a real standalone trunk or a mislabeled segment of the North Gas->Taji->Baghdad distribution system. If unverifiable, downgrade confidence and populate endpoints (currently blank on the sheet).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE (primary concern): the row's ONLY citation on gem.wiki is 'OPEC Annual Statistics Bulletin 2012, p.75' — a generic aggregate that does not name any 'Taji-South Baghdad' pipeline (OPEC ASB does not list domestic Iraqi gas lines by name). That is a textbook non-naming/aggregate support flag. No independent source I could find (EN or AR) names a 'Taji-South Baghdad gas pipeline' or confirms its 56 km / 18 in / 2 bcm/y specs. The sheet itself carries NO start location and endpoints only as 'Iraq -> Iraq'/'Baghdad', reinforcing that this is a thin legacy row. CLASSIFICATION: appears correctly a gas line feeding a gas-fired power plant (not one of the GulfPub crude/NGL lines), so no classification flag. DUPLICATE: considered vs P4054 Taji-Duara (also 18 in): the two most likely endpoints differ — the South Baghdad Thermal power plant is in Al Za'franiya (SE Baghdad) whereas Duara/Al-Dora is SW Baghdad ~15 km away, so probably distinct lines rather than a relabel; duplicate risk judged LOW but not zero (both may be facets of the same Taji-area distribution trunk). Also vs P2233 North Gas-Taji (feeds INTO Taji, 16 in/438 km) — different. WHAT INDEPENDENT SOURCES DO SAY about the Taji gas corridor, and none matches P1845: OGJ ('Iraqis mending own pipelines') describes a 16-in OD natural-gas line supplying the Taji power plant and a 14-in LPG line from south of Baghdad to the Taji bottling plant; Iraq Ministry of Oil (2024) rehabilitated a 12-in dry-gas line East Baghdad field -> Taji power station. All of these feed Taji or run the opposite direction, none is an 18-in/56 km Taji->South Baghdad line. SPEC (secondary): length 56 km, diameter 18 in, and capacity 2.00 bcm/y are all UNVERIFIED; 2 bcm/y (~194 MMcf/d) is far larger than a ~165 MW plant would burn, so the capacity is suspect. Bottom line: the destination facility (South Baghdad Thermal power plant, Al Za'franiya) is real and a Taji->south-Baghdad gas corridor is physically plausible, but this specific named entry and every spec on it rest on a single non-naming aggregate and could not be independently corroborated.

routes.start_name: Taji (Al-Taji gas hub / power-station area, north of Baghdad)
routes.end_name: South Baghdad Thermal power plant, Al Za'franiya, Baghdad (most likely endpoint)
routes.corridor_desc: Loosely bounded N->S corridor down the eastern side of Baghdad: from the Al-Taji industrial/gas hub ~25-30 km north of central Baghdad, southward roughly paralleling the Tigris' east bank / the Baghdad ring, terminating at the South Baghdad Thermal power plant in Al Za'franiya (SE Baghdad). Straight-line Taji->Za'franiya is ~35-40 km, consistent with a 56 km routed length. ENDPOINT AMBIGUITY: GEM records only 'Baghdad' for the end; 'South Baghdad' most plausibly means the South Baghdad Thermal power station (Za'franiya), but the Al-Dora/Doura power plant (SW Baghdad, ~33.258,44.376) is a defensible alternative that would shift the corridor toward the SW. Coordinates are approximate, derived from the named places, not from a sourced route trace. Bound is loose (corridor, not centerline).
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established indirectly: the destination is the real South Baghdad Thermal power plant in Al Za'franiya (confirmed as an operating Baghdad gas/dual-fuel plant; power-technology profile), and the origin is the Al-Taji gas/power hub (a documented Baghdad-area gas node; OGJ). No source gives an actual route geometry for this specific line, so coordinates are approximate place-derived points and the corridor is offered only as a suggestion, not a trace. No coordinates were fabricated; where a point could not be sourced it was left as an approximate district centroid and flagged as such. Note the alternative Doura endpoint.

summary: P1845 Taji-South Baghdad Gas Pipeline: CONCERN/existence - only support is a non-naming OPEC ASB 2012 aggregate, no independent source names the line or confirms 56 km/18 in/2 bcm-y (capacity likely inflated); endpoint facility (South Baghdad Thermal, Za'franiya) is real. Suggested route accuracy: low. Duplicate risk vs P4054 judged low.
